notes.title: 🗓️ Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
[b]Nekograms will launch on Steam on 10 March 🎉[/b]

Puzzle through 120 levels across 3 unique worlds with an unlockable Endless Mode. Help all the kitties to sleep in the least number of moves to collect all the stars.

[b]Wishlist to be notified as soon as Nekograms drops on Steam:[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2478120/Nekograms/

Thank you so much for checking out the Nekograms Demo during Next Fest. It’s still available if you haven't had a chance to check it out.

Kind Regards,
Hungry Sky
